thread:
ana: Hi team, first day! Got my M2 MacBook but enrollment keeps failing after FileVault prompt. Also need Rosetta for a legacy CLI. Any advice?

it-support: welcome Ana! What error do you see after the FileVault prompt? Also, are you on corp wifi or guest?

ana: It prompts to enable FileVault, I accept, it restarts, then shows a dialog: 'Enrollment failed: escrow error (E003)'. I'm on office wifi 'redwood-2g'.

kandji-bot: Device serial: M2X12345 matched to blueprint 'new-hires-standard'. Enrollment: partial. Escrow error E003 recorded. Rosetta: not installed.

it-support: Ok, two quick options: (1) try a wired ethernet at onboarding desk and run a manual escrow retry; (2) we can grant a 48h temporary admin to install Rosetta (safe, audited). Which do you prefer?

ana: I need Rosetta right away to run the onboarding scripts. Temp admin fine.

team-lead: I approve temporary admin for Ana for 48h.

it-support: Got approval. Please DM your serial and a photo of the asset tag to #help, we'll provision a constrained account and message creds. Once you install Rosetta run: `softwareupdate --install-rosetta --agree-to-license` and then reboot. Share `profiles show -type enrollment` after reboot.

ana: Done. Got creds and installed Rosetta. Rebooted. `profiles show -type enrollment` now shows 'Status: Enrolled'. FileVault reports 'On' and `fdesetup status` returns 'FileVault is On'.

it-support: Nice. We'll collect the session logs before revocation for the audit. Reminder: do not disable SIP or uninstall the MDM agent.

devex: If you hit similar issues later we have a cloud devbox that already has Rosetta and the legacy CLI preinstalled; ping me and I'll set one up.

ana: Thanks everyone! All set for the onboarding tasks :smile:
